summary: syrp-events (increment 1): EventLoop, the owned MessageLoop with run/run_for/dispatch_pending/with_token/QuitHandle, real-time phase-keeping timers, the Linux epoll backend, interim backends for macOS (kqueue with a non-coalesced timer) and Windows (condvar at 1 ms timer resolution), a conformance suite shared with ManualLoop, and SYRP-LOOP-0004..0006.
